title: The Decline of 8K Televisions
excerpt: 8K televisions were once presented as the natural successor to 4K, but sales have remained very low and many manufacturers have stopped producing them.
body_html:
When 8K televisions were first introduced, they were widely discussed as the inevitable next step up from 4K resolution screens. However, these devices have struggled to attract buyers.

Sales figures for 8K TVs have remained very low since their market launch. Because consumer demand has not materialized, most companies have largely stopped bothering to manufacture them altogether.
